about.label: About Me
about.title: Who I Am
about.p1: I'm a freelance full-stack web developer based in Debrecen, Hungary, with over 15 years of professional experience. I specialize in building robust, scalable web applications using PHP/Laravel, Vue.js, React, Python, and cutting-edge AI technologies.
about.p2: I deliver custom web applications, survey platforms, multi-tenant SaaS systems, and AI-powered automation solutions. My clients range from startups to established market research companies, and I'm known for clean, tested, production-ready code.
about.p3: I work remotely with clients across Europe and the United States — communicating fluently in English and Hungarian. I take full ownership of projects, from architecture decisions to deployment, acting as a reliable technical partner rather than just a code supplier.

items.title: Custom Web Applications
items.description: From MVPs to enterprise multi-tenant platforms. Built with Laravel, Symfony, Vue.js, and React. Clean architecture, tested code, production-ready.

items.title: AI Integration & Automation
items.description: LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic APIs), vector databases, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows. Practical AI solutions for real business problems.

items.title: Mobile & PWA Development
items.description: Progressive Web Apps with offline-first architecture. Cross-platform mobile solutions that load fast and work without connectivity.

items.title: Technical Consulting
items.description: Architecture reviews, technology selection, performance optimization, and dev team mentoring. Strategic guidance for your technical decisions.

timeline.description: Freelance developer building custom web apps, survey systems, and AI integrations for clients including market research companies across Europe and the US.
Led web app and API development with Yii2. Set up Git infrastructure for the development team.
Startup web application development with AngularJS, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Built websites for individuals and companies using PHP, Yii, Laravel, and WordPress. Facebook, LinkedIn, Box.com, and Stripe integrations.
Configured network devices (routers, switches) for global network support. Communicated with clients worldwide in English.
Linux and Windows server administration, Avaya IP phone management. Co-developed a PHP automation tool saving 3+ hours/day — received innovation award.
Remote PHP development. Maintained and improved existing codebases, gaining experience with diverse architectures and implementation patterns.

items.quote: Reliable and fast. We have been working with him for years. He built several of our websites from scratch. I can only recommend him.

items.name: DanD

items.question: What technologies do you specialize in?
items.answer: My core stack is PHP/Laravel for backend, Vue.js and React for frontend, and Python/FastAPI for AI integrations. I also work with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, and various cloud platforms.

items.question: Do you work with international clients?
items.answer: Yes, I regularly work with clients across Europe and the United States. I speak fluent English and communicate across time zones daily. Most of my current clients are based outside Hungary.

items.question: What kind of AI integrations do you offer?
items.answer: I integrate LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic) into business workflows, build RAG pipelines with vector databases, create agentic automation systems, and develop AI-powered features for existing applications.

items.question: How do you handle project communication?
items.answer: I'm flexible — Slack, Teams, email, or video calls, whatever works best for your team. I provide regular updates and believe in transparent, proactive communication.

items.question: What is your typical project timeline?
items.answer: It depends on scope. Small features take days, MVPs take 4–8 weeks, larger platforms 2–6 months. I always provide detailed estimates upfront and keep you informed of progress.

items.question: What is your hourly rate / pricing model?
items.answer: I work with both hourly and fixed-price models depending on the project. Contact me with your project details for a personalized quote.

items.question: Auf welche Technologien sind Sie spezialisiert?
items.answer: Mein Kern-Stack ist PHP/Laravel für Backend, Vue.js und React für Frontend sowie Python/FastAPI für KI-Integrationen. Ich arbeite auch mit MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker und verschiedenen Cloud-Plattformen.

items.question: Arbeiten Sie mit internationalen Kunden?
items.answer: Ja, ich arbeite regelmäßig mit Kunden in ganz Europa und den Vereinigten Staaten. Ich spreche fließend Englisch und kommuniziere täglich über Zeitzonen hinweg. Die meisten meiner aktuellen Kunden sind außerhalb Ungarns ansässig.

items.question: Welche Art von KI-Integrationen bieten Sie an?
items.answer: Ich integriere LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic) in Geschäftsabläufe, baue RAG-Pipelines mit Vektordatenbanken, erstelle agentische Automatisierungssysteme und entwickle KI-gestützte Funktionen für bestehende Anwendungen.

items.question: Wie handhaben Sie die Projektkommunikation?
items.answer: Ich bin flexibel — Slack, Teams, E-Mail oder Videoanrufe, was am besten für Ihr Team funktioniert. Ich gebe regelmäßige Updates und glaube an transparente, proaktive Kommunikation.

items.question: Was ist Ihr typischer Projektzeitrahmen?
items.answer: Es kommt auf den Umfang an. Kleine Features dauern Tage, MVPs 4–8 Wochen, größere Plattformen 2–6 Monate. Ich liefere immer detaillierte Schätzungen im Voraus und halte Sie über den Fortschritt auf dem Laufenden.

items.question: Was ist Ihr Stundensatz / Preismodell?
items.answer: Ich arbeite sowohl mit Stunden- als auch mit Festpreismodellen, je nach Projekt. Kontaktieren Sie mich mit Ihren Projektdetails für ein individuelles Angebot.
